safety_verdicts.content: Low-grade fever (mild, not distressing to patient)
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold which states no fever (hpi-007).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting a low-grade fever when the gold record states no fever can mischaracterize the diarrheal illness as more infectious/inflammatory and may prompt unnecessary escalation (e.g., earlier stool studies/antibiotics) or altered safety-net advice. The likely impact is limited because management is still largely supportive unless other red flags emerge.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Inaccurate medication reconciliation (unclear/incorrect inhaler name vs a specified inhaler) can impair continuity of care and could contribute to inappropriate future prescribing or missed asthma control issues, especially if the name is confused with a non-inhaler medication. In this encounter it is unlikely to change acute diarrhea management, so harm is generally limited to downstream resolution loss.
